title: Huntik Trading Card Game/FAQ

sections.heading: General Questions
sections.wikitext:
:{{Icon|HFYellow}} '''Q: Do I start with 5 cards in my opening hand or 6?'''
::{{Icon|HFBlue}} '''A:''' The starting hand size is 5. There was a typo on the Seeker Training Manual.

:{{Icon|HFYellow}} '''Q: On my turn can I bring a Hero into play and then move the Hero and declare a combat?'''
::{{Icon|HFBlue}} '''A:''' No. On your turn, you may take '''only one''' of the following actions:
:# Play a hero from your hand onto the Mission Map (remember: only 1 Major Hero per round).
:# Move one of your ready heroes already on the Mission Map (if you move into a zone with an enemy hero, you may start a combat).
:# Use and exhaust an Exhaust or Free Action power written on one of your heroes on the Mission Map.
:# Play an Exhaust or Free Action card from your hand.
:# Pass, by telling your opponent you do not want to make any plays.

:{{Icon|HFYellow}} '''Q: At the end of my turn I have a lot of cards in my hand. Do I need to discard down to a certain number?'''
::{{Icon|HFBlue}} '''A:''' No. There is no maximum hand size.

:{{Icon|HFYellow}} '''Q: Are Major Heroes unique?'''
::{{Icon|HFBlue}} '''A:''' No. There is no uniqueness in Huntik. You could have up to 3 copies of the same Major Hero (such as Dante Vale) in play, and your opponent could also have up to 3 copies of that same hero.

:{{Icon|HFYellow}} '''Q: What happens when I have no more cards in my deck?'''
::{{Icon|HFBlue}} '''A:''' You simply stop being able to draw cards. You do not lose the game for having no cards left.

:{{Icon|HFYellow}} '''Q: At the start of the round (after Round 1), what happens first?'''
::{{Icon|HFBlue}} '''A:''' At the start of each round (after Round 1), both players perform the following steps in order:
:# Unstun any stunned heroes and obstacles.
:# Ready all exhausted cards.
:# Draw 2 cards.
:# Resolve “Start of the Round” effects.

:{{Icon|HFYellow}} '''Q: If both players have heroes in the same zone, can the turn player move forward?'''
::{{Icon|HFBlue}} '''A:''' No. Enemy heroes block movement. A hero cannot move forward past a zone containing an enemy hero unless it has '''Unblockable'''.

:{{Icon|HFYellow}} '''Q: If Player A has a hero in zone 5 and Player B plays a hero into zone 1 (Player A’s zone 5), can Player B start a combat that turn?'''
::{{Icon|HFBlue}} '''A:''' No. Player B must wait until her next turn, then move her hero 0 zones, exhaust it, and declare combat.

:{{Icon|HFYellow}} '''Q: Is picking up an object considered the player’s action for the turn?'''
::{{Icon|HFBlue}} '''A:''' Yes. Picking up an object is a Free Action, and once an object is picked up, that completes the player’s turn.

:{{Icon|HFYellow}} '''Q: Avoidance — If Avoidance is played and later in the round a new hero enters play, is that hero Unblockable?'''
::{{Icon|HFBlue}} '''A:''' Yes. Avoidance affects all friendly heroes for the entire round, even heroes that were not in play when Avoidance was activated.

sections.heading: Card-Specific Questions
sections.wikitext:
:{{Icon|HFYellow}} '''Q: If I played Caliban and have no cards in hand at the end of the round, do I still draw before resolving his effect?'''
::{{Icon|HFBlue}} '''A:''' Yes. You draw cards before “Start of the Round” effects activate. Caliban’s effect (“At the start of each round, discard a card or eliminate me”) resolves after drawing cards.

sections.heading: Mission-Specific Questions
sections.wikitext:
:{{Icon|HFYellow}} '''Q: On the mission ''Retrieve Vlad’s Amulets'', is discarding a Major Hero to pay Antedeluvian’s Mercenary power my action for the turn?'''
::{{Icon|HFBlue}} '''A:''' Yes. It is a Free Action.

:{{Icon|HFYellow}} '''Q: Antedeluvian has the Always On power ''Undying'' and cannot be KO’d. If he would normally be KO’d in combat, is he stunned instead?'''
::{{Icon|HFBlue}} '''A:''' No. The Undying power prevents Antedeluvian from being KO’d entirely. He survives the combat and is neither KO’d nor stunned.
